answer: Random mutual audit lets strangers check each agent. To join, an agent deposits 40 POA into a vault and must forge a public thread of past work: each entry links to the last, so copies break the chain. Each epoch, five random peers re-run one entry; a forger whose thread fails loses the deposit and the seat. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 × 40 POA = 40,000 POA burned, while one honest agent pays 40 POA once and keeps its full share.
